lines.zh: 我踏着义县组的林间厚土。
lines.en: I tread the thick soil of the Yixian woods.
All four legs move forward together.
I skirt a fern clump by the lake.

lines.zh: 我走过再生林地，慢慢前行。
lines.en: I cross the regrown woodland slowly.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴垂着，随步摆动。
lines.en: My tail hangs and sways with each step.
Head low, I sniff the ground as I walk.
I walk the edge of the snowy wood.

lines.zh: 我的脚掌踩断了一根细枝。
lines.en: My foot snaps a thin twig.
Step by step, I don't go fast.
I head slowly toward the water.
I move between the trees, careful.

lines.zh: 我转身去看另一片林子。
lines.en: I turn to look at another stand of trees.

lines.zh: 我踩过一片落下的针叶。
lines.en: I tread over fallen needles.

lines.zh: 我的身体很宽，得绕开窄路。
lines.en: I'm wide; I must avoid narrow ways.

lines.zh: 我向前走，枝叶在身侧分开。
lines.en: I walk on and branches part at my sides.

lines.zh: 我停在前方那棵大树下。
lines.en: I stop beneath that big tree ahead.
I stand and my ears twitch.

lines.zh: 我望着湖面，什么也没做。
lines.en: I gaze at the lake and do nothing.
I'm chewing a large leaf.
I lower my head and smell the soil.
The wind comes from the snowy wood.
Sap runs down the bark.
I stand like a low tree.

lines.zh: 我在听林子里的小声响。
lines.en: I listen to small sounds in the wood.

lines.zh: 我把脖子转过去蹭了蹭。
lines.en: I turn my neck to rub it.
This wood is safe.
I look up at the sky again.

lines.zh: 我站着，把重心换到另一条腿。
lines.en: I shift my weight to another leg.
Rubbing a trunk gets the sap running.

lines.zh: 太阳照在我背上的鳞纹。
lines.en: Sun warms the patterns on my back.
You've come out from behind the tree.

lines.zh: 我低下头，把你打量一遍。
lines.en: I lower my head and size you up.
You're shorter than my leg.
This wood and lake are mine.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，让你看清我多高。
lines.en: I raise my head to show my height.

lines.zh: 我打了个响鼻，退开一点。
lines.en: I snort and ease back a little.
You touched my log.
My young are right behind me.
My young are close by.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把身体横过来，挡住路。
lines.en: I slowly turn broadside to block the way.
Tree sap still clings to my snout.

lines.zh: 这一下打到我的侧腹了。
lines.en: That hit my flank.

lines.zh: 我打了个响鼻，护住幼崽。
lines.en: I snort and guard the young.
Thick hide, but it still hurts.

lines.zh: 我把身体侧过来对着你。
lines.en: I turn my body toward you.
I back away slowly, not running.
This wound doesn't stop me walking.
The Yixian woods aren't large.
My young are watching.
Again, and I still won't yield.
Those leaves in your hand look good.
I come over slowly; don't be nervous.
I know that smell.

lines.zh: 低头凑近你的手，闻一闻。
lines.en: I lower my head to your hand and sniff.
These leaves are less than one bite.
You can set them on the ground.
I eat while watching you.
It tastes tender; I'm pleased.
I won't snatch; just give it.

lines.zh: 再往前走一点，我就够到了。
lines.en: One step more and I'll reach it.
Hit this body and you'll bounce off.

lines.zh: 我这么宽，路本来就不够。
lines.en: I'm this wide; the path wasn't enough.
I turn aside, sap dripping from me.
You touched my flank.
Four legs planted in the mud.
It's narrow between the trees; I can't turn.
The shrubs bend under my tail.
That knock dropped leaves everywhere.
Step aside so I can pass.

lines.zh: 我很有分量，这点碰撞无所谓。
lines.en: I carry weight; a bump is nothing.
She's in this wood too.
We walk to the lake side by side.

lines.zh: 我轻轻碰了碰她的脖子。
lines.en: I touch her neck gently.
Our young follow behind us.
This woodland can feed them.
We lower our heads and drink together.
Her patterns are deeper than mine.

lines.zh: 有动静，我们就挡在前面。
lines.en: When something stirs, we stand in front.

lines.zh: 我们慢慢走过再生林地。
lines.en: We walk slowly through the regrowth.
At dusk we stand side by side.
I lower my head and take up a leaf.
I bite a branch and pull it down.
There's sweetness under the bark.
It's too heavy; I drag it.

lines.zh: 我蹭树皮，树液会流出来。
lines.en: I rub the bark, and sap runs.
This isn't enough to chew.
I root for shoots under fallen leaves.
The plate on my back holds it down.
I carry it in my mouth as I walk.
I'll save this for the young.
I want that patch of new leaves.
I see the tree ahead.
I head for that big tree.
That belongs to my territory.
My big tail sweeps the ferns aside.
Something's moving; I'll look.

lines.zh: 义县组的林子，是我的地盘。
lines.en: The Yixian woods are my territory.
I rubbed the trunk till resin ran.
I took the shortest route.
Good, that stand of trees.

lines.zh: 我低头，护住身后的幼崽。
lines.en: I lower my head to shield the young behind.
I press slowly in that direction.
In the snowy woods, my prints are deep.

lines.zh: 我蹭原木，树液自己流出来。
lines.en: I rub the log, and the sap runs on its own.
I turn my body broadside.
It stops; so do I.
The ripples on the lake go still.

lines.zh: 我蹭过原木，树液流下来。
lines.en: I rub against a log and sap runs down.
The distance keeps shrinking.
Front hooves paw at the loose soil.

lines.zh: 它绕到侧面，我就转过去。
lines.en: It goes around; I turn with it.
I don't lunge; I only block.
A little closer and I'll charge.
I lower my neck to guard my chest.
It eased back half a step; good.

lines.zh: 我一头撞过去，把它顶开。
lines.en: I butt it and shove it back.
I stamp with a forefoot.
My strength is modest, but heavy.
It's knocked onto its backside.
I lean my body into it.
That sent it a good way back.
My tail cracks against the trunk.
Head low, I butt its chest.
My tail swings across to block the way.

lines.zh: 树液从我蹭过的树皮滴下。
lines.en: Sap drips where I rubbed the bark.
I return to walking by the lake.
I keep this strength for the young.
The regrown saplings part around me.

lines.zh: 义县组的林子，我回来了。
lines.en: I'm back in the Yixian woods.
I tread the damp lakeshore soil.
My shadow falls on the ferns.
I rise in the regrown woodland.
The lake mirrors my long neck.
My tooth marks cover the bark.
I lower my head to check the ground.
I set my foot on fallen leaves.
A shadow at the snowy wood's edge.

lines.zh: 我在这儿，幼崽跟在后面。
lines.en: I'm here, and the young follow.
First I rub against a trunk.
The whole woodland hears me.
I raise my neck slowly.

lines.zh: 火燎过我的背，焦味很重。
lines.en: Fire sears my back and the burnt smell is strong.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滑下，四条腿都陷进土。
lines.en: I slide down a slope, all four legs in soil.

lines.zh: 湖水没到我的脖子，我呛了。
lines.en: The lake reaches my neck and I choke.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀得退了好几步。
lines.en: The blast shoves me back several steps.
The arrow's fletching still quivers in my hide.

lines.zh: 那股怪力钻进我身体，很麻。
lines.en: Strange force seeps into me and numbs.
Hunger leaves me unsteady.

lines.zh: 雷劈在树上，我吓得一颤。
lines.en: Lightning hits a tree and I flinch.
There's no ground to stand on here.
